name: Da Lat Flower Festival
summary: The 11th edition in 2026 opens at 20:00 on 19 December at Lam Vien Square and closes with a New Year programme at 20:00 on 31 December. Flower displays run about 18 December 2026 through 3 January 2027 around Xuan Huong Lake and central parks. Vietnam Tourism lists the festival in December of odd years; later civil dates are check on arrival.
when: 19–31 Dec 2026 for main ceremonies; displays through 3 Jan 2027. Odd-year December pattern; confirm future years on arrival.
